rules: Choose one category by dominant instructional or narrative purpose.
Category is broad; topics describe subjects; keywords are retrieval terms; entities are named referents.
Do not infer entity identity from resemblance.
Use other_uncertain when evidence is insufficient or mixed; include reason and require review.
Taxonomy approval is manual and cannot authorize provider execution.

boundaries.technology: Software, computing, devices and technology methods.
boundaries.culture_reading: Books, reading, arts and cultural interpretation.
boundaries.home_building: Home maintenance, construction, design and building.
boundaries.business_branding: Business operations, marketing, branding and sales.
boundaries.other_uncertain: Insufficient evidence, unresolved overlap or outside proposed categories.
